scope: All tracked files before repository-wide English translation, plus the two explicitly archived preceding live ledgers. This manifest does not hash itself.
interpretation: Original SHA-256 values in historical run/review records and standalone .sha256 files remain identities of the actually executed original artifacts. english_sha256 values below identify current English reading copies and documentation, not newly generated model results.
original_access: Original bytes are preserved in Git at source_commit; use each original_url or git show with the source commit and source_path.
adaptations: Synthetic ASR misspellings have English counterparts, retaining deliberate errors and unresolved sent/received distinctions.
Explicit historical Chinese-language requests and Chinese-character limits remain historical conditions, described in English.
Multilingual dependency patterns and regression inputs retain their original runtime strings using Unicode escapes in English Python source.
Historical text line counts, stable HTML anchors, path/ID fields, status values, and original hash identities are preserved. Summary and navigation documents carry explicit translation notices.
